dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare beneficiaries utilizing mental health services, psychiatric hospitals, and primary care practices seeking technical assistance for behavioral health integration.
Changes lifetime limits and financial protections for patients receiving inpatient psychiatric hospital services under Medicare.
dimensions.evidence: No reduction shall be made under the preceding sentence with respect to inpatient psychiatric hospital services furnished to an individual on or after October 1, 2027

dimensions.assessment: Appropriates unspecified necessary sums for fiscal years 2027 through 2031 for technical assistance and implements temporary payment rate increases for behavioral health integration services under Medicare.
dimensions.evidence: there is appropriated to the Secretary for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as are necessary

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple sections of the Social Security Act concerning Medicare coverage, provider regulations, and payment incentives.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to ensure appropriate access to mental health care under the Medicare program.

dimensions.assessment: Permanently removes the 190-day lifetime limit and financial reductions for certain commitments starting in 2027, while integration incentives apply to specific years through 2029 and funding runs through 2031.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by subsection (a) shall apply to items and services furnished on or after October 1, 2027.

missing_information: Exact dollar amounts for appropriations labeled as 'such sums as are necessary'.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill alters Medicare rules regarding mental health care, removing lifetime limits and financial protections for involuntary commitments, modifying provider regulations, and providing increased payment incentives and funding for behavioral health integration.
